members.bio: Community Tool Library Trustee and NeighbourLend Admin. Passionate about zero-waste neighborhood initiatives and shared stewardship.
Weekend woodworker and garden hobbyist. Happy to lend high-quality power tools and yard gear to respectful neighbours!
Outdoor lover and camping enthusiast. Lending outdoor expedition tents, hiking gear, and carpet extractors.
DIY enthusiast and mechanic. Always up for tool exchanges and helping neighbours with heavy home tasks.

equipment.name: EGO Power+ 21" Cordless Self-Propelled Electric Mower
equipment.description: High-torque brushless electric lawn mower with dual 56V 5.0Ah ARC Lithium batteries and rapid charger. Effortless push-button start, 6-position height adjustment, and grass collection bag. Zero emissions and whisper-quiet operation.
equipment.pickupInstructions: Pick up from front garage side gate. Please return with deck cleaned of damp grass cuttings.
equipment.safetyInstructions: Always remove battery key before clearing chute. Safety eye protection and sturdy boots required.

equipment.name: Simpson PowerShot 4200 PSI Pro Gas Pressure Washer
equipment.description: Industrial-strength commercial pressure washer with Honda GX390 engine and AAA industrial triplex plunger pump. Includes 50ft steel-braided hose, quick-connect nozzles (0°, 15°, 25°, 40°, soap), and surface cleaner disc.
equipment.pickupInstructions: Owner will demonstrate starting procedure and hose attachment on collection. Fuel must be regular unleaded.
equipment.safetyInstructions: Never point high-pressure stream at people, pets, or electrical boxes. Wear safety goggles and hearing protection.

equipment.name: DeWalt 20V MAX XR Brushless Hammer Drill & Impact Driver Combo
equipment.description: Heavy-duty 2-tool combo kit with 3-speed hammer drill, high-torque impact driver, two 5.0Ah batteries, fast charger, and 30-piece drill/driver bit set in TSTAK hard case. Ideal for masonry drilling, framing, and deck builds.
equipment.pickupInstructions: Available for evening or weekend pickup from covered porch lockbox (code provided upon booking approval).
equipment.safetyInstructions: Clamp workpieces securely. Do not exceed recommended torque for small fasteners.

equipment.name: North Face Mountain 25 Geodesic 4-Person 4-Season Tent
equipment.description: Bombproof 4-season all-weather expedition tent with lightweight aluminum DAC poles, dual doors, fully taped waterproof rainfly, interior gear loft, and snow stakes. Kept in pristine condition, dried and aired after every trip.
equipment.pickupInstructions: Pick up anytime between 8 AM and 7 PM. Includes footprint ground tarp and stake puller.
equipment.safetyInstructions: Never cook or operate open flames inside the tent. Ensure tent is fully dry before returning.

equipment.name: Harper Heavy-Duty 800lb Convertible Appliance Dolly & Hand Truck
equipment.description: Community sharing item provided free to local neighbours for weekend moves! Converts easily from 2-wheel upright hand truck to 4-wheel platform cart with pneumatic tires and stair-climber glides. Solid steel construction.
equipment.pickupInstructions: Community equipment shed beside Sector 4 community center. Access code sent on confirmed booking.
equipment.safetyInstructions: Secure heavy appliances with ratchet straps (straps provided in bottom pouch). Do not overload above 800 lbs.

equipment.name: Stihl Cordless 24" Dual-Action Hedge Trimmer
equipment.description: Free neighbor-shared 36V hedge trimmer. Diamond-ground blades slice cleanly through branches up to 3/4 inch. Light, well-balanced, and zero fumes. Comes with blade guard, battery, and safety glasses.
equipment.pickupInstructions: Collect from Sarah at Cedar Heights. Happy to provide a quick 2-minute safety walk-through.
equipment.safetyInstructions: Two-handed grip required at all times. Keep hands away from blade teeth even when halted.
